'''Plautopseum''' was an ancient member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who had attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]]. Ancient accounts kept safe by the Order claimed that Plautopseum had passed into [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] upon [[Death/Legends|dying]] and transcended death by returning as a [[Force ghost/Legends|phantom]]. Along with Masters [[Galong-Tal]] and [[Arca Jeth]], Plautopseum's story was recovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] within a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] following the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="TJP" />
